scope: Compiled production HTTP with disposable synthetic accounts and real restart/restore
checks: two invitation activations sign in directly; web and native sessions share the exact client identity
native API stores trips, expenses, income and receipt; retry is idempotent and stale overwrite is rejected
client portal shows own exact synced records; forged client selection and foreign receipt access cannot cross accounts
authorized tax staff sees those same records; client cannot administer accounts
client submits a requested private tax document, foreign account is denied, authorized staff downloads identical bytes and records review
client account, session and shared journal persist across a real server restart
verified full-volume backup restores account, web/native sessions, journal, receipt and requested tax-document bytes
revoking one account immediately removes app and portal access after recovery
